figure.title: Surviving Attributed Paintings by Dutch Golden Age Painter

problem.passage:
An art historian compiled data on the number of surviving paintings attributed to four Dutch Golden Age painters, based on museum catalog records. The results are shown in the table below.

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to support the claim that Painter C has the fewest surviving attributed paintings among the four painters studied?
problem.stimulus: An art historian compiled data on the number of surviving paintings attributed to four Dutch Golden Age painters, based on museum catalog records. The results are shown in the table below.
problem.question: Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to support the claim that Painter C has the fewest surviving attributed paintings among the four painters studied?
options: Painter A has 65 surviving attributed paintings, the most of the four painters studied
Painter B has 48 surviving attributed paintings, more than both Painter D and Painter C
Painter D has 34 surviving attributed paintings, fewer than both Painter A and Painter B
Painter C has only 12 surviving attributed paintings, fewer than any of the other three painters
problem.explanation: 지문의 주장은 Painter C가 네 화가 중 가장 적은 현존 작품 수를 가진다는 것이다. 표에서 Painter C의 값 12는 네 화가 중 최솟값이므로 이를 인용한 D가 정답이다. A는 최댓값(Painter A)을, B와 C는 각각 Painter B와 Painter D의 값을 인용해 Painter C에 대한 주장을 뒷받침하지 못한다.
problem.explanationEn: The claim is that Painter C has the fewest surviving attributed paintings among the four painters. According to the table, Painter C's value of 12 is the lowest of the four, so choice D, which cites this figure, correctly supports the claim. Choice A cites the maximum value (Painter A), while choices B and C cite the values for Painter B and Painter D, respectively, none of which supports the specific claim about Painter C.
problem.evidenceSpan: Row: Painter C, Column: Number of Surviving Paintings = 12
problem.answerRationale: 정답은 자료의 최솟값 12(Painter C)를 인용해 최소값 주장을 정확히 뒷받침한다.

difficultyReasons: 표에서 한 항목이 나머지 세 항목보다 모두 작은지 확인하는 1단계 비교만 필요함
정답이 명시적으로 '다른 세 화가 모두보다 적다'는 표현을 사용해 주장과 직접 대응됨
오답들은 각각 다른 화가에 대한 부분적 비교만 제공하여 질문의 초점(C가 최소)과 어긋남을 쉽게 파악 가능

distractors.plausibleBecause: 표에서 가장 큰 수치를 언급하여 데이터 기반처럼 보임
distractors.whyWrong: Painter C가 가장 적다는 주장과 무관하게 Painter A가 가장 많다는 것만 보여줌

distractors.plausibleBecause: Painter C보다 많다는 비교를 포함하고 있어 관련 있어 보임
distractors.whyWrong: 이 선택지는 C가 가장 적다는 것을 직접 증명하지 않고, B가 D와 C보다 많다는 것만 보여줌 (C가 D보다 적다는 것은 보여주지만 A와의 비교가 빠짐)

distractors.plausibleBecause: D가 A와 B보다 적다는 비교를 통해 최소값을 암시하는 것처럼 보임
distractors.whyWrong: D가 A, B보다 적다는 것만 보여줄 뿐 C와의 비교가 없어 C가 가장 적다는 것을 지지하지 못함
